```sql
SELECT MIN(strftime('%Y-%m-%d', substr(Date,7,4)||'-'||substr(Date,4,2)||'-'||substr(Date,1,2))) AS min_date,

       COUNT(*) AS row_cnt
FROM walmart_sales;
```

占比：
```sql
WITH s AS (SELECT Store, SUM(Weekly_Sales) AS total_sales FROM walmart_sales GROUP BY Store),
     t AS (SELECT Store, total_sales FROM s ORDER BY total_sales DESC, Store ASC LIMIT 5)
SELECT (SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_sales),2) FROM t) AS top5_sales,
       (SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_sales),2) FROM s) AS all_sales,
       ROUND(100.0*(SELECT SUM(total_sales) FROM t)/(SELECT SUM(total_sales) FROM s),2) AS top5_share_pct,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t) AS top5_cnt,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s) AS all_cnt;
```
